question: 'Kalarathnam' from Kerala Kalamandalam 2016 and 'Kalaasree' 2011 from the Kerala Sangeetha Natak Akademi was awarded to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunanda Nair.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunanda Nair** is an Indian **classical dancer and choreographer**, known for her expertise in **Mohiniyattam **and contemporary dance. 
 
• She has been awarded the **Kalarathnam from Kerala Kalamandalam in 2016** and the **Kalaasree from Kerala Sangeetha Natak Akademi** in **2007.**
 
• Kalarathnam is a prestigious award for excellence in Indian classical dance, **presented annually **by the Kerala Kalamandalam.
 
• Kalaasree is also a prestigious award for **excellence** in Indian classical dance, **presented annually **by the Kerala Sangeetha Natak Akademi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian dancer and choreographer **Jatin Goswami** is regarded as one of the leading practitioners of the** Sattriya** classical dance style.

 
 
• In **2008**, the Indian government bestowed upon him the fourth-highest civilian honor, the **Padma Shri.**
 
 
 
• **Anuradha Pandey** is an Indian classical **dancer and choreographer.**
 
• **M.R Krishnamurthy** is a renowned Indian **classical dancer.**
 
 
• In the well-known dance-dramas of **Kalakshetra,** he portrayed prominent roles.
